description: This file defines the 'Extension' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for internal CRT extension handling. It forwards method calls to the underlying AWS CRT PHP extension functions and ensures the extension is loaded during instantiation.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: A final class that forwards calls to the awscrt PHP extension functions, ensuring the extension is loaded during instantiation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that checks if the 'awscrt' extension is loaded and throws a RuntimeException if not.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls by forwarding them to the corresponding extension functions with the given arguments.

calls: throw new RuntimeException('awscrt extension is not loaded')
